notes: University Park, single track (no options) -- historical catalog-year build. Fetched the real archived 2024-2025 bulletin page at the URL above (raw HTML, table rows parsed directly rather than trusting an AI summary, per the WebFetch-hallucination caution) and confirmed its Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs are byte-identical in course list, per-semester credit placement, and credit total (121cr across the 8-semester table; the Program Requirements tab's own summary table states 'a minimum of 120 credits is required') to the 2025-2026, ...2025-2026 and current live 2026-27 editions -- cross-checked the same way against all of 2022-23 through 2026-27 directly (5 editions total), all identical. Same modeling conventions as TURF-2026.json (this file mirrors its JSON shape as instructed): 'CHEM 130' picked over 'CHEM 110' for the Semester 1 choice to avoid CHEM 110's MATH 140/141/22 concurrency requirement that this major's own MATH 21 entry course doesn't satisfy; 'TURF 495' (Internship, appears 3 times in the real per-semester table -- Third Year Summer, Third Year Spring, Fourth Year Fall) modeled as generic slots, with the Third Year Summer appearance folded into Semester 7 (Fourth Year Fall) alongside the real Fourth Year Fall appearance since this schema has no separate summer term; 'TURF 490' has an unmodeled semester-standing prereq; 'Supporting Course' pools modeled generically (no enumerated department list published, confirmed on this year's own archived page); MATH 3/MATH 4 added to Semester 1/2 for the same real MATH 21 prereq chain (MATH 21 needs MATH 4, MATH 4 needs MATH 3) documented in TURF-2026.json -- this chain lives in the shared, non-year-versioned math_catalog.json the planner engine actually reads, so it applies identically regardless of catalog_year. REAL DIVERGENCE FROM TURF-2026.json'S OWN NOTES: this year's raw archived table places 'Elective' (3cr) in Third Year SPRING (this file's Semester 6, real total 17cr including the elective, matching the table's own printed '17' subtotal) and has NO elective in Third Year Fall (Semester 5, real total 15cr, matching the table's own printed '15' subtotal) -- confirmed by parsing this year's actual <table> rows directly, not an AI summary. This is the opposite of what TURF-2026.json's notes field describes (it says it 'confirmed' the real elective belongs in Semester 5/Third Year Fall at an 18cr real total and moved it there from Semester 6). Re-checked the current live 2026-27 bulletin page the same raw-table way as part of this pass and got the same result as every archived year: Third Year Fall=15 (no elective), Third Year Spring=17 (with elective) -- so this file places Elective in Semester 6 to match what the bulletin actually shows across all 5 checked editions (2022-23 through 2026-27), rather than copying TURF-2026.json's placement; TURF-2026.json itself was left untouched (out of scope for this pass) but its own Semester 5/6 elective placement and Semester 5 target_credits (states 15 but its own items sum to 18) appear to be a real, pre-existing bug worth a follow-up fix.
